cases.title: Record standard visited link to Global History
cases.description: Verify that visiting a standard URL records the link to the Global History.

cases.title: Record multiple unique valid URL protocols to Global History
cases.description: Verify that links accessed using different unique valid URL protocols are properly recorded to Global History.

cases.title: Record correct redirected link to Global History
cases.description: Verify that after a server redirect, the correct final link is recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Record correct link after multiple redirect hops
cases.description: Verify that the final target link is correctly recorded to Global History when a page goes through multiple server redirect hops.

cases.title: Launch History Link in Browser Window
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a history link causes the corresponding URL to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Launch History Link from Different Grouping Modes
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a history link successfully launches the URL when the history view is grouped by Day, Site, and None modes.

cases.title: Delete a single history entry
cases.description: Verify that a single selected history entry can be successfully deleted from the Global History.

cases.title: Delete the last remaining history entry
cases.description: Verify that deleting the very last remaining entry in the history list properly removes it and leaves an empty history state.

cases.title: Delete multiple selected history entries
cases.description: Verify that selecting multiple history entries and performing a delete action removes all selected entries from the history view.

cases.title: Delete all history entries simultaneously
cases.description: Verify the boundary scenario where all history entries present in the list are selected and deleted simultaneously, ensuring none are displayed afterward.

cases.title: Delete non-contiguous multiple history entries
cases.description: Verify that non-contiguous multiple history entries selected by the user are successfully deleted and no longer displayed in the history list.

cases.title: Clear Entire Global History
cases.description: Verify that executing the clear Global History command removes all recorded history items from the browser history storage and UI.

cases.title: Group history items by Day
cases.description: Verify that history items are correctly grouped by Day in the history view.

cases.title: Group history items by Site
cases.description: Verify that history items are correctly grouped by Site in the history view.

cases.title: Group history items by None
cases.description: Verify that history items are displayed without grouping when the grouping option is set to None.

cases.title: Group history items with mixed timezone timestamps and special character site names
cases.description: Verify that history grouping functions correctly when handling mixed timezone timestamps and site names containing special characters.

cases.title: Sort and reverse-sort History columns
cases.description: Verify that History columns can be sorted in ascending order and reverse-sorted in descending order when clicking column headers.

cases.title: Sort History columns with identical timestamps or titles
cases.description: Verify the stability and deterministic ordering when sorting history columns that contain identical timestamps or titles.

cases.title: Resize History Columns to Show and Hide Text
cases.description: Verify that history columns can be resized using the mouse to show more or hide parts of the entries.

cases.title: Persist History Column Widths Across UI Reopens
cases.description: Verify that custom history column width states persist correctly across UI close and reopen actions.

cases.title: Show and Hide History Columns via UI Toggles
cases.description: Verify that history columns can be successfully shown and hidden using the UI column toggle controls.

cases.title: Simultaneous Hiding of All Optional History Columns
cases.description: Verify the layout integrity and application behavior when all optional history columns are hidden simultaneously via the UI toggles.

cases.title: Re-visit site via Back button dropdown menu
cases.description: Verify that clicking the Back button dropdown menu allows the user to select and re-visit a recently visited site.

cases.title: Re-visit site via Forward button dropdown menu
cases.description: Verify that clicking the Forward button dropdown menu allows the user to select and re-visit a site after navigating backwards.

cases.title: Create new session history file on new browser window
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is successfully created when a new browser window is opened.

cases.title: Create new session history file on browser restart
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is successfully created upon restarting the browser.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, and cover the requirements comprehensively without any blockers.

analysis.analysis: Unit: firefox_browser_history. R-073: Normal scenario records standard visited links to Global History; actionable missing scenario includes validating recording behavior for unique valid URL protocols. R-074: Normal scenario records the final redirected URL after a server redirect; actionable missing scenario handles single-hop vs multi-hop redirection chains. R-075: Normal scenario launches clicked history link in a browser window; actionable missing scenario verifies link launching from different view grouping modes (Day/Site/None). R-076: Normal scenario deletes a single history entry; actionable missing scenario ensures dependent UI lists update correctly upon deletion. R-077: Normal scenario deletes multiple selected entries and removes them from display; actionable missing scenario verifies batch deletion performance and non-contiguous selection removal. R-078: Normal scenario clears entire Global History; actionable missing scenario confirms persistence across application restarts following a clear action. R-079: Normal scenario groups history items by Day, Site, and None; actionable missing scenario verifies grouping behavior with mixed timezone timestamps and special character site names. R-080: Normal scenario sorts and reverse-sorts per column; actionable missing scenario tests sorting stability with identical timestamps or titles. R-081: Normal scenario resizes history columns to show and hide more entries; actionable missing scenario verifies column width state persistence across UI reopens. R-082: Normal scenario shows and hides history columns via UI toggles; actionable missing scenario checks layout integrity when all optional columns are hidden simultaneously. R-083: Normal scenario accesses recently visited sites via Back and Forward button dropdown menus; actionable missing scenario validates dropdown navigation correctness after session restoration. R-084: Normal scenario creates a new, empty session history file for a new browser window or a restart; actionable missing scenario verifies file initialization when previous session files are missing or corrupted.
